name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart and received a chat completion from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API. The response was: "Hello in Spanish is **¡Hola!**". I followed the quickstart instructions using the OpenAI Python SDK approach (install openai, set FIREWORKS_API_KEY, create client with base_url=https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1, call chat.completions.create).
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", but that model returned a 404 "Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed" error. I queried the available models endpoint and substituted "accounts/fireworks/models/glm-5p2", which worked and returned the chat completion.
